tool_input.description: List data dir and show schema

tool_input.command: head -5 data/transactions_export_1.csv && echo "---" && wc -l data/transactions_export_1.csv data/transactions_export_2.csv

hops fg create transactionsd9e8d1 --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --features "row_id:string,account_id:string,event_time:bigint,amount:double,category:string" \
  --online \
  --description "Transactions feature table with online store enabled" \
  --json 2>&1

mkdir -p .tmp
# header from file1
head -1 data/transactions_export_1.csv > .tmp/combined.csv
# data rows from both, dedup by row_id (col1) keeping first occurrence
awk -F',' 'FNR==1{next} !seen[$1]++' data/transactions_export_1.csv data/transactions_export_2.csv >> .tmp/combined.csv
echo "combined rows (incl header):"; wc -l .tmp/combined.csv
echo "unique row_ids in raw union:"; awk -F',' 'FNR==1{next}{print $1}' data/transactions_export_1.csv data/transactions_export_2.csv | sort -u | wc -l
echo "head:"; head -3 .tmp/combined.csv
tool_input.description: Build deduplicated union CSV by row_id

tool_input.command:
head -1 data/transactions_export_1.csv > .tmp/combined.csv
awk -F',' 'FNR==1 {next} !seen[$1]++ {print}' data/transactions_export_1.csv data/transactions_export_2.csv >> .tmp/combined.csv
wc -l .tmp/combined.csv
echo "unique union row_ids:"; awk -F',' 'FNR>1 {print $1}' data/transactions_export_1.csv data/transactions_export_2.csv | sort -u | wc -l
tail -3 .tmp/combined.csv

head -1 data/transactions_export_1.csv > .tmp/combined.csv
awk -F',' 'FNR==1 {next} {if (seen[$1]++ == 0) print}' data/transactions_export_1.csv data/transactions_export_2.csv >> .tmp/combined.csv
wc -l .tmp/combined.csv
tail -2 .tmp/combined.csv

tool_input.description: Insert combined data into feature group

tool_input.command:
hops fg preview transactionsd9e8d1 --version 1 --json 2>&1 | tail -25
echo "=== SQL count (offline) ==="
hops sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS uniq FROM transactionsd9e8d1_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Preview FG and count offline rows

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS uniq FROM transactionsd9e8d1_1" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Count offline rows with TLS verify off

tool_input.command: hops fg info transactionsd9e8d1 --version 1 --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"name"|"version"|"online_enabled"|"primary_key"|"event_time"|"row_id"' | head -20
